title: 👀A Visual Personal Tags System 📢
summary: This post describes a custom personal tagging system for Business Central that uses colors and emojis to visually categorize and identify records across different entity types. The system enables user-scoped tags that help users organize and quickly recognize records without affecting other users.
key_points: Tags work universally across any Business Central table including customers, vendors, orders, and items
Visual design uses emoji and color combinations for immediate recognition and priority identification
User-scoped implementation stores tags in two linked tables without impacting other users
Integration occurs through FactBox UI elements added to entity card pages for easy tag management
Eight codeunit functions handle core operations: creating, assigning, removing, searching, and retrieving tags

quotes.text: A tagging between entities that works universally across different types of records.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the core capability of the system to work with any BC table, making it adaptable across the platform

quotes.text: User scoped tags without affecting others.
